raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to decisively resolve the discrepancy between the release years of "Taxi Zum Klo" (1980 vs. 1981) despite credible evidence from IMDb and other sources supporting 1980 as the original release year in West Germany. Instead, the Planner introduced unnecessary ambiguity by focusing on broader US release contexts, which were irrelevant to solving the problem of determining which film was released first worldwide. This misdirection led to confusion and delayed the clear identification of "Saajan Bina Suhagan" (1978) as the earlier release.
